adapters.description: Comma-separated selected Playstack adapter names used to resolve adapter:<name> conditions.

persistence.description: Persistence ownership used to resolve package-authored persistence conditions and decisions.

adoptionMode.description: Migration phase recorded in the integration plan.

decisions.description: JSON object mapping package-authored decision keys to selected string values.

conditions.description: JSON object mapping human-readable package conditions to booleans.

equivalences.description: Reviewed JSON mapping of environment keys to names, module/provider symbols to existing:file#export, or package:integration:template keys to existing:file.

verification.description: Reviewed JSON map from each package:integration:test ID to an existing project:target.

verificationProject.description: Existing Nx project receiving the playstack-verify aggregator target.

ciWorkflow.description: Explicit existing GitHub workflow to augment after review.

ciJob.description: Explicit existing CI job receiving the verification step; install/toolchain setup remains repository-owned.

migrationStages.description: Reviewed JSON package:integration transition map with stage, verificationReport and rollbackPlan paths; separate from advisory adoptionMode.
